slot-8e82805b-ac83-452f-bd94-a896e6585d5.quote_span: Bipartisan leaders from the powerful House Energy and Commerce Committee launched an inquiry on Wednesday into the Amateur Athletic Union, criticizing the sprawling youth sports organization for its handling of child sexual abuse allegations and demanding answers, citing reporting by ProPublica and The Washington Post.

evidence.title: U.S. Lawmakers Launch Sexual Abuse Probe of Youth Sports Giant AAU

occurrences.checkable_against: Brett Guthrie statement on the AAU inquiry
occurrences.quote_span: The committee chair, Kentucky Republican Brett Guthrie, called ProPublica and The Post’s reporting “deeply disturbing” in a statement on Thursday, saying it “raises serious questions about the organization’s actions over the past decade.”
occurrences.speaker: Brett Guthrie
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: “It is unacceptable that AAU is failing to implement standard reforms to protect child athletes, and is misleading the public, parents, and athletes about preventative measures in place within AAU sports,” the letter reads.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: Signed House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: The letter is signed by Guthrie, ranking Democrat Frank Pallone Jr. from New Jersey and representatives in charge of oversight and investigations.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: Signed House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: The letter is signed by Guthrie, ranking Democrat Frank Pallone Jr. from New Jersey and representatives in charge of oversight and investigations.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: Among questions about its safety policies and coach training, the committee asks Mirza to lay out how many sexual abuse allegations the nonprofit receives each year and how many coaches it disciplines, information that has long been shrouded in secrecy.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: The members of the committee, which in 2018 investigated systemic failures surrounding sexual abuse by former USA Gymnastics doctor Larry Nassar and others, said in the letter that they were “seeing parallels” between its past investigation and “what is being uncovered within the AAU today.”
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: AAU statement responding to the congressional inquiry
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement, the AAU said, “As always, we will cooperate fully and respond appropriately to any questions or requests from congressional committees or U.S. government agencies.”
occurrences.speaker: Amateur Athletic Union
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: Brett Guthrie statement on the AAU inquiry
occurrences.quote_span: “Our Committee is seeking information on how the AAU’s policies have potentially fallen short, and what needs to be done in order to protect young athletes,” Guthrie said.”
occurrences.speaker: Brett Guthrie
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.quote_span: Bipartisan leaders from the powerful House Energy and Commerce Committee launched an inquiry on Wednesday into the Amateur Athletic Union, criticizing the sprawling youth sports organization for its handling of child sexual abuse allegations and demanding answers, citing reporting by ProPublica and The Washington Post.

occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza and Safe Sport Act statutory text
occurrences.quote_span: The Energy and Commerce Committee’s letter cites that provision of the law and demands that the AAU explain how it complies.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee

occurrences.checkable_against: House Energy and Commerce Committee letter to Jo Mirza
occurrences.quote_span: The letter is addressed to Jo Mirza, the AAU’s president, and asks detailed questions about the organization’s operations, taking the extra step of demanding a briefing from Mirza to the committee by Oct. 21.
occurrences.speaker: House Energy and Commerce Committee
occurrences.subject: House Energy and Commerce Committee
